title: Deep stretching of the sciatic nerve Pelvic stabilization #mobility #yoga #sciatica #shorts
description:
• iliopsoas muscle work • lumbar spine decompression
This technique targets deep myofascial chains: it reduces lumbar compression, improves pelvic mobility, and decreases tension along the course of the sciatic nerve.
⚠️Please be attentive.
This is a strong and deep method. In the initial stages, temporary discomfort or symptom flare-ups may occur - this is a normal adaptive response of the tissues as they reorganize toward a new, more functional structure
